tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Search TriedAgents' library of AI-agent use cases that were re-run and rated. Use this when the user asks whether an AI agent can really do a task (e.g. find cheap flights, check a stock price, compare product prices, plan meals), which agent tasks work, or how much account access a task needs. Matc

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: Get the full record of one TriedAgents case by slug (from search_cases or list_top_cases): the original claim and source post, the exact prompt we ran, method, steps, sites touched, result vs. ground truth, each checked claim, score, verdict, access level, failure modes, time, cost and a ready-made

tools.name: list_top_cases
tools.description: List TriedAgents cases ranked the way the site ranks them: reproduced (V2) first, then partly reproduced (V1), failed (F), not yet run (V0); higher score first within a verdict. Use this for 'what can AI agents reliably do?', 'best agent use cases' or 'what failed?' questions, optionally within one

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List TriedAgents' case categories (with counts and page urls) and explain the rating rubric: verdicts V2/V1/F/V0, the score out of 10, and access levels L0-L4. Use this to understand the ratings or to pick a category filter for search_cases.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_cases, get_case, list_top_cases, list_categories · Private data: search_cases, get_case · Public sink: get_case · Destructive: search_cases, list_top_cases.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_cases, get_case, list_top_cases, list_categories · Private data: search_cases, get_case · Public sink: get_case · Destructive: search_cases, list_top_cases

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
